title: London-based defense simulation software startup Agon raised $70M led by Northzone at a $450M valuation, after emerging from stealth with $30M earlier in 2026 (Mark Bergen/Bloomberg)
summary: Mark Bergen / Bloomberg: London-based defense simulation software startup Agon raised $70M led by Northzone at a $450M valuation, after emerging from stealth with $30M earlier in 2026 — Agon, a UK startup that makes simulation software for the European defense industry, has raised $70 million from investors including …
